description: VN existential-have calque: locative-fronted 'have' should become English there-is/there-are.
fp_risk_note: High. 'have' is overwhelmingly correct possession ('I have a car', 'We have a meeting'). Restrict strictly to a closed locative-fronted existential frame and never rewrite possessive, auxiliary, or already-correct there-is/there-are surfaces.

positive.input: In my city have many parks.
positive.expectedCorrection: There are many parks in my city.
positive.notes: Plural NP after locative-fronted have -> there are.

positive.input: In the box have a book.
positive.expectedCorrection: There is a book in the box.
positive.notes: Singular NP after locative-fronted have -> there is.
Bare locative adverb fronting -> there is ... here.

negative.notes: Possessive have with personal subject must not become existential there-is.

negative.input: There are many parks in my city.
negative.expectedCorrection: There are many parks in my city.
negative.notes: Already-correct existential there-are surface must stay unchanged.
